import subprocess

# Check git status
status = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--short"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
print("=== GIT STATUS ===")
print(status)

# Check git log
log = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "--oneline", "base..HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
print("=== GIT LOG ===")
print(log)

# Check diff from base
diff = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "base", "--", "semver.py"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
print("=== DIFF FROM BASE (first 3000 chars) ===")
print(diff[:3000] if len(diff) > 3000 else diff)
